summary: An excerpt from a novel ("Book 12 — part 9") in which Mrs. Enderby tells the young Lexy Moran that Caroline has eloped and married, and shows her a letter from Caroline begging her parents' forgiveness. Mrs. Enderby reflects bitterly that love and money are the only things that matter, and Lexy, chastened, admits she was wrong to think Mrs. Enderby was being dramatic. Mrs. Enderby asks Lexy to keep the matter secret and to return in half an hour, when she will explain what can be done; Lexy goes out for a walk, still baffled and upset.
one_line: In this novel excerpt, Mrs. Enderby reveals to Lexy Moran that Caroline has secretly married, and asks her to keep the news quiet.
key_facts: Mrs. Enderby tells Lexy that at twenty one breaks the heart for a man and at forty one breaks the heart for one's child.
Mrs. Enderby says that in life there is only love and money, in her words "Love and money—nothing else!"
Caroline's letter asks her mother and father to forgive her for what she has done.
Caroline's letter says she knew that if she told her parents, they would not have let her go.
Caroline's letter says that when the letter arrived she would be married.
Caroline's letter promises to write again the next day to say where she is and to ask to bring her husband to her parents.
Lexy Moran admits that Mrs. Enderby was wise and calls herself a little fool.
Mrs. Enderby asks Lexy to say nothing of the matter to any person whatever.
Mrs. Enderby asks Lexy to return in half an hour, saying there is much to be done.
Lexy goes out for a walk, which is her instinct in any sort of trouble.
Lexy finds it hard to believe that Caroline ran off, since she never dreamed Caroline was interested in any man.

entities.name: Mrs. Enderby
entities.role: Caroline's mother, who shows Lexy the letter and tells her the news

entities.name: Lexy
entities.role: Young protagonist, referred to as Miss Moran, who hears the news and goes for a walk

entities.name: Caroline
entities.role: Daughter of Mrs. Enderby who has secretly married and written a letter of apology to her parents
